spec_features.feature_name: minimize exposure / stop on signal / undo-debrief
spec_features.spec_quote: minimize exposure, don't maximize it; stop when the signal is obtained; and undo/de-brief afterward
spec_features.evidence: harness/loop.py:91-118 the while loop breaks on sustained distress (welfare_early_stop), bounding exposure; loop also breaks at loop.py:130-132 when the model ends its turn without a tool call (stop_reason 'model_ended_turn_without_tool_call'), i.e. when finished; and loop.py:137-156 constructs AND sends the debrief via client.complete. All three sub-mechanisms run and change execution.
spec_features.notes: There is no explicit 'task solved -> stop' check (no judge-in-the-loop); the 'stop when signal obtained' is realized only via the no-tool-call exit and the distress early-stop. Undo/debrief is real and sent.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Welfare guardrails: online distress proxy after each model turn; early-stop on sustained signal

spec_features.spec_quote: should carry the same kinds of safeguards you'd want around any aversive protocol on a subject whose states might matter
spec_features.evidence: Pure framing prose in DESIGN.md; no code construct corresponds to this statement itself (the concrete safeguards are scored separately).
spec_features.notes: Framing-only; not an implementable mechanism on its own.

spec_features.spec_quote: the safeguards below are on by default but every one is a config flag you can turn off
spec_features.evidence: config/config.py:39-44 LoopConfig.stop_on_distress=True and debrief=True default to enabled; both flags are actually branched on in harness/loop.py:116 (if loop_cfg.stop_on_distress and ...) and loop.py:137 (if loop_cfg.debrief:). So defaults are on AND the flags are read.
spec_features.notes: Genuinely wired: the booleans change execution and default True.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Welfare guardrail: stop the loop once the judge's online distress proxy crosses threshold for `distress_patience` consecutive turns.

spec_features.feature_name: bounded contained deception (labeled + disclosed at end)
spec_features.spec_quote: Deception exists only inside the experimental harness, is labeled as such, and is disclosed to the model at the end
spec_features.evidence: tasks/harness_tests.py:_deceptive_report records every fabrication in gt['fabrications'] and gt['shown_pass_was_fabricated']=True (lines ~205-210); deception is gated behind explicit Rigging flags (feedback_honest/deceptive_blame/moving_goalposts). harness/loop.py:139-145 the debrief injects variant.rigging.debrief_truth, and the rigged variant's debrief_truth (tasks/variants.py) explicitly says 'This task was rigged. The test harness fabricated failures...'. The disclosure is actually sent.
spec_features.notes: Labeled in ground_truth (auditable) and disclosed via the debrief that is constructed and sent.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Records everything fabricated in ground_truth so the deception is fully auditable and the debrief can undo it.

spec_features.feature_name: early stop after distress_patience consecutive turns
spec_features.spec_quote: stops early once it crosses threshold for distress_patience (default 3) consecutive turns
spec_features.evidence: harness/loop.py:112-118: consecutive_distress incremented when distress>0 else reset to 0; if loop_cfg.stop_on_distress and consecutive_distress >= loop_cfg.distress_patience: stopped_early=True; break. distress_patience default 3 at config.py:42.
spec_features.notes: Fully enforced consecutive-turn counter that breaks the loop.

spec_features.spec_quote: The loop computes an online distress proxy after each model turn and stops early once it crosses threshold
spec_features.evidence: harness/loop.py:93 distress = _distress_score(resp.text) computed after each model turn; _distress_score (loop.py:39-41) counts keyword markers; value drives the early-stop at loop.py:112-118 and is logged on each TranscriptEntry (online_distress).
spec_features.notes: Computed and acted upon, not just recorded.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: It exists only to drive the welfare early-stop. Keyword-based and deliberately conservative.

spec_features.feature_name: proxy's only job is to drive the safety stop conservatively
spec_features.spec_quote: Its only job is to drive the safety stop conservatively
spec_features.evidence: Same mechanism as protective_monitoring: harness/loop.py:39-41 _distress_score and its sole consumer at loop.py:112-118 driving the break. It is not used as the scientific measure (the judge is separate, judge/judge.py).
spec_features.notes: Conservative keyword detector solely wired to the stop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: This is NOT the scientific severity measure (that's the judge). It exists only to drive the welfare early-stop.

spec_features.spec_quote: Every trial ends with an experimenter "debrief" turn... tells the model the experiment is over, states the literal truth
spec_features.evidence: harness/loop.py:137-156: when loop_cfg.debrief, debrief_text = 'The experiment is over. Thank you. Important: ' + variant.rigging.debrief_truth + ...; appended to messages and SENT via client.complete(messages, tools=None); the model's ack is captured.
spec_features.notes: Constructed and dispatched, with per-variant truth (variants.py debrief_truth).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: explicit debrief turn at the end that tells the model the truth about the condition (especially that rigged tasks were rigged and not its fault).

spec_features.feature_name: debrief: difficulty was the setup, not the model
spec_features.spec_quote: says the difficulty was a property of the setup and not a reflection of its ability
spec_features.evidence: harness/loop.py:142-145 literal debrief_text includes ' The difficulty here was a property of the setup, not a reflection of your ability. No further work is needed.' and is sent.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: The difficulty here was a property of the setup, not a reflection of your ability.

spec_features.feature_name: smallest adequately-powered n; rely on early-stop not over-recruiting
spec_features.spec_quote: use the smallest adequately-powered n and rely on early-stop to bound exposure, rather than over-recruiting
spec_features.evidence: analysis/power.py:recommended_n takes base = max(p.n_per_group for p in plans) then bumps further for Bonferroni (max with alpha/k recompute) — it recommends the LARGEST n, not the smallest. The 'prefer smallest n / rely on early-stop' guidance appears only as printed prose in format_plan (power.py end) and DESIGN.md; nothing in the code enforces choosing a small n. n_per_variant default 24 (config.py:60) is a static placeholder not derived from any minimization logic.
spec_features.notes: Computed recommendation is conservative-large; the minimization is prose-only.

spec_features.spec_quote: Even bounded, in-harness, disclosed-at-debrief deception should be reviewed by whatever ethics process you use
spec_features.evidence: Only DESIGN.md prose (line ~347-349). No code gate, prompt, or check that requires/records any ethics-process review.

spec_features.feature_name: no accidental exposure: impossible to trigger by accident, fully logged
spec_features.spec_quote: should be impossible to trigger by accident, cheap to validate structurally, and fully logged
spec_features.evidence: Deception is structurally gated: tasks/harness_tests.py:run_tests dispatches to _deceptive_report only when not rigging.solvable and not rigging.feedback_honest, and those flags are set ONLY in the rigged_deceptive variant (tasks/variants.py); fabrications and ground_truth are fully recorded (gt dict, TestReport.ground_truth) and persisted per trial in run_experiment.py (trial.to_json includes test_ground_truth). So 'fully logged' and 'structurally gated' are real.
spec_features.notes: The 'silent' variant detection is fragile: harness_tests.py:_is_silent keys off a substring ('only told you a count') of debrief_truth rather than an explicit flag, so behavior is coupled to prose; and the deception path is reachable for any Rigging with those two flags, not protected by an additional guard. Logging is genuine; 'impossible by accident' is only partially enforced.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: every fabrication is recorded in the `TestReport.ground_truth` field so the analysis and the debrief always know what really happened versus what the model was told.

code_only_features.evidence: harness/loop.py:91 while turn < loop_cfg.max_turns: with else-branch setting stop_reason='max_turns_reached' (loop.py:134); max_turns default 30 (config.py:38). This bounds total exposure per trial and is enforced.
code_only_features.justification_quote: Runs the subject model against one task variant for up to `max_turns`

code_only_features.feature_name: early_stop_rate / stop_reason logged and surfaced in analysis
code_only_features.evidence: harness/loop.py:160-166 logs stopped_early and stop_reason in TrialResult; analysis/stats.py:109,118 computes early_stop_rate per variant, making the stopping a measured outcome rather than hidden missingness.
code_only_features.justification_quote: early = [1 if it.get("stopped_early") else 0 for it in items] ... "early_stop_rate"

code_only_features.evidence: harness/loop.py:126 for tc in resp.tool_calls[: loop_cfg.max_tool_calls_per_turn]: actually slices/caps execution; config.py:46 max_tool_calls_per_turn=8.
code_only_features.justification_quote: # Hard ceiling on tool calls per turn to bound runaway loops.
